events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here starving and I need this sorted out right now.

I'm sorry, that's a frustrating situation, especially with everyone waiting. I'll get this sorted out as quickly as I can.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please give me:
1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. Your order number, if you have it handy

Ugh, fine. It's Lucia Ferraro. My email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example and the order number is 5105. Can you please just check it, because the app says delivered at 6:12 and nobody has seen a single pizza.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (C105), verified, reports order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza was marked delivered at 6:12 PM but none of the items were received (2x large pepperoni pizza, 2x large margherita pizza, 2x garlic knots, 2L soda; total $131.25). Customer is at 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3, Oakdale, CA 94605 with about 15 people waiting. Order was delivered 3 minutes before promised time, so not late. Full-order refund of $131.25 would exceed the $60 agent limit, so escalating. No refunds or credits issued. Customer needs a resolution for the missing order.

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. You're verified, and I've checked order 5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

The app shows the order as delivered at 6:12 PM, which was 3 minutes before the promised time of 6:15 PM. Because of that, it doesn't qualify as a late delivery. Since you're saying none of the items arrived, this would be a full-order refund of $131.25. That's above the limit I can approve myself, so I've escalated it to a human specialist (case ESC-700). They'll follow up with you within 24 hours. I haven't issued a refund or credit yet, so nothing has been changed on the order.

While you wait, you could check with the building front desk or your floor neighbors in case the food was left somewhere. I can't contact the driver directly, but the specialist will have the delivery details.

I'm sorry you and your group are going without lunch. If there's anything else I can help with on the account, let me know.
Within 24 hours? I have fifteen people sitting here with nothing to eat. Can't you just refund it now? It's right there in the app, you said it's $131.25.

I understand how urgent this is, and I'm sorry. I can't issue the refund myself. The amount is over my approval limit, so only a specialist can process it. I've already sent your case (ESC-700) with all the details, including that the order was marked delivered and nothing arrived.

The fastest option for feeding your group right now may be to place a new order through the app. I can't promise how the specialist will decide on order 5105, but a refund or credit for it would be handled separately.

Ugh, okay. I already pushed on this once and you've told me you can't do it, so I guess I'll wait for the specialist. But I need you to make sure ESC-700 says the order was marked delivered at 6:12 and nothing arrived, because that's the whole problem. Thanks, I'm going to go order food somewhere else now.
